messages:
Mai: Quick question — for audit export samples, do we include tenant_id on every change event or only at the batch header? downstream SIEM folks need consistent mapping. :thinking:
Sanjay: lean towards putting tenant_id on every event. makes streaming consumers simpler and avoids header parsing bugs.
Alex: +1 for per-event. also makes partial retries less painful.
Kira: worry: that means we might be exporting tenant identifiers into customer-managed S3 buckets for exports. need legal on PII classification. :lock:
Mai: good point. can we include tenant_id but have a redaction mode for exports tied to account settings? e.g., export.redact_tenant=true
Sanjay: implementation note — if we add per-event tenant_id, we should also add tenant_resolution metadata so consumers can decide to map vs display. suggestion: "tenant_id" + "tenant_display": "marketing-prod"
Alex: can we instead include a hashed_tenant_id by default and allow unhashed with an opt-in flag? reduces accidental leaks.
Kira: hashed id helps, but for compliance we sometimes need raw tenant for investigations. need export ACLs and an audit trail showing who requested the raw export.
audit-bot: Export job 0912 started by Kira (role: security) — streaming NDJSON -> s3://redwood-exports/2165432100/  
Mai: +1 on ACL + human approval for raw tenant. For the payload shape, what about adding an "actor_resolution" block so callers don't have to re-resolve actor IDs? sample:
```json
{
  "event_type": "route.update",
  "occurred_at": "2026-03-20T15:02:13Z",
  "actor": {"id":"u-987","display":"sanjay"},
  "tenant": {"id":"t-123","display":"marketing-prod"},
  "diff": {"route":{"from":"/v1","to":"/v2"}}
}
```
Sanjay: that looks fine. keep diff small and machine-friendly (ndjson per line). prefer no embedded arrays of big objects.
Alex: operational questions: export quotas — do we rate-limit full-tenant exports? we need a circuit to prevent a runaway full-history dump.
Kira: yep. propose: require a ticket/approval for >30 days of history or >100M events. auto-throttle otherwise.
Mai: UX side — console should show redaction toggle and last-approver + export TTL. Also show a sample row in the UI so customers see hashed vs raw.
Sanjay: API: POST /v1/audit/exports with body {range, redact:bool, include_actor_resolution:bool, out_format: ndjson|zip} — response 202 + job id.
Alex: include a preview endpoint GET /v1/audit/exports/:job_id/sample that returns first 5 lines (hashed by default).
Kira: security: log who previewed and redact previews in logs.
Mai: action items: 1) spec payload shape (Sanjay) 2) add redact/hash toggle + approval flow (Kira) 3) console sample + toggle (Alex) 4) add quota/circuit doc (Mai). I'll file tickets.
Sanjay: filing PR for schema this afternoon.
Alex: I'll mock the console sample component.
Kira: I'll coordinate legal on PII definitions and the approval workflow.
Mai: thanks — if anyone thinks hashed-only is better default, speak now or file a follow-up. :thumbsup:
Alex: thumbs-up from me.
Sanjay: 👍
Kira: 👍
Mai: audit-bot: please attach job summary to the ticket once PR merges.
audit-bot: Noted. Job 0912 completed (size: 4.2MB, events: 7,982)
